name: Inu
source:
A girl is dragged into the manhole to the sewers. She does not know anymore whether she's dead or alive, asleep or awake... what's the meaning of such life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名少女被拖进了下水道的井盖。她已经分不清自己究竟是死是活、是在睡梦中还是清醒着……这样的生活，到底意味着什么？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
